mentions.name: Frost-e
mentions.description: An autonomous snow clearing robot built on the thesis that, instead of pursuing capital-intensive general-purpose robotics (multi-task, multi-environment humanoids), current technology can be deployed cheaply to robustly automate one specific task in one environment.
mentions.problem: Solving the general case in robotics (multiple tasks, multiple environments, generalization) requires billions in capital; this project targets the narrower problem of robustly and cheaply automating a single task in a single environment.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on an autonomous snow clearing robot: https://www.frost-e.com/
mentions.author: martythemaniak
